svg.aria-label: Ahmad Hassan: blue light beams flow from his fields into an ASCII portrait of him, above a short bio
svg.text: I study how brains turn noise into meaning,
and build machines that try to do the same.
Most days that means agents, retrieval and GPU inference.
Most nights it means music, and Dostoevsky read like a research paper.

text.tspan: Spiking networks and neural dynamics: what brains know that transformers don't.
Multi-agent systems that notice when they're wrong, and change course.
CUDA kernels and serving stacks. The best model is the one you can afford to run.
I produce, and I wrote my own BPM, key and scale detector to do it.
Dostoevsky, Kafka, Tolstoy. The oldest working models of the human mind.

svg.text: Ask me about agents, RAG, or the last book I finished.
